Three reasons to intern at SAP 1. 2. Culture of collaboration: meet with mentors, make new friends across the globe and create a thriving personal network. What you'll do Position Title: SAP iXp Intern - Production Services, Developer Location: Vancouver, BC Expected Start Date: 4 May 2026 Contract Duration: 8 months Work Hours: 40 hours per week We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our team as a SAP iXp Developer in Production Services Canada. The primary responsibilities of this role include Release Assembly, Support Package and Patch Assembly for products in maintenance, Build & monitoring tasks, setup & support of deployment pipelines, Code Signing, and consulting for development teams for assembly and software delivery processes. In addition, the successful candidate will be involved in process automation in the mobile automation & operation area providing new functionality and bug fixing to our internal development departments. They will also be responsible for providing software packages via various provisioning points directly to our customers, such as APP Stores and SAP One for Me. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and the ability to collaborate with global teams in Germany, India & Ireland. Experience with SAP products and technologies is highly desirable. If you are passionate about innovation, have a strong attention to detail, and are looking for an opportunity to work with cutting- edge technologies in a global team environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. • After an intensive on-the-job training in a highly motivated team, you'll directly step in our daily tasks. • You will be responsible for the Assembly and publishing of SAP Mobile Apps for Apple, Android, and Microsoft platforms: starting from setup and operation of release builds, analyzing and tracking errors, managing of release metadata until publishing on the app stores. • Be innovative & involved in internal run AI projects. • Perform operational and automation task for SAP mobile Apps, Setup, monitor non-ABAP based CI/CD pipelines. • Further develop/maintain internally used digital Signing Server, Apple Notarization & tasks in customer-based CI/CD projects. • You will help develop in new topics • You will work closely with global developers, Quality Management, Translation, and Infrastructure teams, gaining a strong network within the SAP organization. Career development opportunities with the possibility of leading Production projects and cross department projects. • Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential.
